text.title: 树隙间的山谷
text.situation:
走到坡中，露丝在树木间能望见山谷的位置停下。游客小屋周围的草地和疏林变成农田与林坡。玛雅说景色壮观，随后放低声音：下方很宁静，只在远处房屋上方有一道烟。展板展示这个地区五十年前的样子。照片里的山丘看似未受破坏，但露丝指出树中藏着一条旧路。

玛雅：整个地区从未有人动过吗？
露丝：不是。未受破坏描述自然面貌，不表示从未有人住过。
乔：山谷看起来比身后的路安静多了。
她们在树隙旁站了一会，等那家人追上。

paragraphs.en: Halfway up, Ruth stopped where the trees opened onto a valley. The parkland around the hut gave way to fields and wooded slopes. Maya called the view spectacular, then lowered her voice: the scene below was serene, with only a line of smoke above a distant house. A panel showed the same region fifty years earlier. The hills looked unspoiled in the photograph, but Ruth pointed out an old road hidden among the trees.

paragraphs.en:
Maya: Was the whole region untouched?
Ruth: No. Unspoiled describes its natural appearance; it does not mean nobody has ever lived here.
Jo: The valley looks much quieter than the road behind us.
They stood at the gap until the family caught up.
